CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 19, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Grijalva, Ho, Olson, Tsujii, Garcia, Wang

  Absent:  Gardea, Juarez, Mojarro, Pham

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Maia
  McCurley, Senior Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Wang

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  RESOLUTION OF DENIAL FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT
  PERMIT PD-23-41 AND VARIANCE VAR-23-12 (7:02 P.M.)
  x Request: This is a Resolution of Denial for Planned Development
  Permit PD-23-41 and Variance VAR-23-12 to establish a remote
  commercial kitchen facility with less than the required number of
  parking spaces within an existing 4,450 square foot commercial
  building, located at 1117 East Main Street in the EMC (East Main
  Commercial) zone. This Resolution of Denial memorializes the
  Planning Commission’s 7-1 decision to deny the application at its
  meeting of June 5, 2023.
  x Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-11 denying Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-41 and Variance VAR-23-12, and
  finding the denial of Planned Development Permit PD-23-41 and
  Variance VAR-23-12 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15270 of
  Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from
  CEQA review projects which a public agency rejects or disapproves.

  MOTION:
  x  Moved to approve.
  x  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  x  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  1
  06/19/2023
   Roll Call Vote: 5-0-1-4
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Olson, Tsujii, Garcia, Wang
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Ho

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – JUNE 5, 2023 (7:03 P.M.)
  x Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the June 5, 2023, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  x Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the June 5, 2023, Regular Meeting of the

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  PRESENTATION SERIES ON THE COMPREHENSIVE ZONING
  CODE UPDATE (7:13 P.M.)
  x This is the eleventh continuation of the eighth presentation in a series
  2
  06/19/2023
   of presentations on the Comprehensive Zoning Code Update project
  presented by Planning Division Staff.
  x  Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.
  x  The public comment portion of the Discussion Item was opened
  and closed.
  x  Public Comments:
  1.) Bert Ng
  2.) Jennifer Ng
  3.) Lewis McCammon
  x  Recess at 7:34 P.M.
  x  Reconvene at 7:40 P.M.

  x  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  x  There were no Public Hearing items.

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  x  Jennifer Ng noted her appreciation for the proposed new drive-through use standards,
  and then inquired about when the re-zoning of the parcel at 21 South Cordova Street
  will be discussed. Ms. Ng also discussed the need to identify EPA superfund sites in
  the City and to discuss concerns related to these sites with City Council. (9:20 P.M.)

  x  Alexandre Colis from the AD 49 Youth Leadership Program commented on
  homelessness and affordable housing in Alhambra, and the efforts of the San Gabriel
  Valley Consortium on Homelessness. Mr. Colis also discussed ensuring community
  events are more inclusive. (9:22 P.M.)

  x  Bert Ng commented on the re-zoning of the parcel at 21 South Cordova Street, and
  inquired about the public and Commission’s opportunity to review and discuss the
  tables of all the parcels proposed to be re-zoned as part of the Zoning Code Update.
  (9:27 P.M.)

  x  Lewis McCammon commented on AB 2011 and SB 6, and their respective impacts
  3
  06/19/2023
   upon the City. Mr. McCammon referenced the EPA’s specific standards for thresholds
  of toxicity, which could be utilized by the City, and then commented on the State’s
  housing goals for the City and the site inventory the City prepared for the Housing
  Element Update. Mr. McCammon also discussed the Juneteenth holiday. (9:29 P.M.)

  x  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video

H.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING
  REPORTS:

  x  Commissioner Olson asked if the re-zoning of the property at 21 South Cordova Street
  will be discussed during the next meeting. (9:35 P.M.)

  x  Vice President Garcia inquired about Staff’s recommendation for the re-zoning of the
  property at 21 South Cordova Street and asked if the concern was related to the split
  zoning designation of the property. Vice President Garcia asked for clarification on the
  format of the Zoning Code Update public hearing. (9:36 P.M.)

  x  President Wang requested there be discussion on the re-zoning of the parcel at 21
  South Cordova Street at the next meeting, and then asked for clarification on the
  content being presented during the Zoning Code Update public hearing. President
  Wang also commented on the viewing settings for those participating in the Planning
  Commission meetings via Zoom. (9:37 P.M.)
